# Getting started

This page takes you from an invitation email to your first sent invoice. It
takes about ten minutes.

## Sign in

Open the address in your invitation and sign in with the email address the
invitation was sent to. Fernwell Ledger sends you a six-digit code; type it in
and you are through. You will not be asked for a password.

If the code does not arrive within two minutes, ask for another one. Codes
expire after ten minutes, so the one in an old email will not work.

## Name your workspace

Your workspace is where your team's invoices live. Give it the name your
clients would recognise, because it appears at the top of everything you send.
You can rename it later from **Settings → Workspace**.

## Add your first client

Open **Clients** and choose **Add client**. Fernwell Ledger asks for a name, a
billing address and one email address to send invoices to. Everything else can
wait until you need it.

## Draft an invoice

Open **Invoices → New invoice**, pick the client you just added, and add a line
for the work. Fernwell Ledger totals the lines for you and applies whatever tax
rate your workspace is set to.

Save the draft and read it once more before you send it. A sent invoice can be
credited but not edited, which is what your accountant would want.

## Send it

Choose **Send**. Your client is emailed a link, and Fernwell Ledger tells you
when they have opened it. From here the invoice moves through **Sent**,
**Viewed** and **Paid** on its own.
